## Expected and actual behavior

## Reproduction

Command, OS/architecture, `sky --version`, and relevant sanitized output. Never include API keys or private local data.

## Impact

Does this affect correctness, quotas, data persistence, or installation?

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Failure is reproduced with a local fixture where feasible
- [ ] Fix and regression validation recorded

## Rollback

Previous working release/checkpoint, if known:
